## Scope

Can test: the layout and names ctx reads, fractional length-scaled counts, a sample with two runs merged, single- and paired-end samples, auto and reverse strandedness.

Cannot test: GENCODE and `--gencode`; single-end 75-101 nt human reads; the cluster's Nextflow 26.04.4 with Apptainer; the test GTF has transcripts with empty IDs, which the cluster GTF does not.
